dog.description_text:
Her official rescue name may be inspired by one of the greatest shows ever, but she goes by (and responds to) Ava!

Ava is an incredibly sweet, playful pup. While the shelter perceived her to be about 1-2 years old, we (her foster parents) think she may be closer to 1 year old, as she acts a lot like an older puppy.

We have absolutely loved fostering Ava so far. She is curious, energetic, loving, and just wants to be a good girl. She loves people, and shows nothing but friendly curiosity when interacting with other dogs, and loves when she finds a playmate that can match her energy! She likes to wrestle and play with our resident chihuahua mix multiple times per day. We think she would also be copacetic with cats and children.

Ava is a smart girl — she learned to sit within 2 days, and was pottying outside by day 3 (she is not yet house-trained). Leash manners have improved with each day, but she's definitely still working on zig zagging. She is a bit of a velcro dog and loves to be near and keep watch on her humans, but we have left her alone for short periods with a bit of minimal whining.

As evidence of how sweet she is, she let us trim her nails on the first night!

3 Keywords that describe Ava: sweet, playful, goofy
Defining features: an adorable underbite, and a single little white patch on her back
Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high energy): 6
Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: can have her moments, but leans more towards quiet
Appetite: strong!!
Favorite things: toys and treats
Least favorite things: robot vacuums

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
dog.name: Hacks (Ava)
